question: The most important achievement of Shishunaga was ____.

options.text: defeating Avanti (Malwa) and annexing it to Magadh

solution:
The correct answer is __**defeating Avanti (Malwa) and annexing it to Magadh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shishunaga**, the founder of the Shishunaga dynasty, ruled Magadh in ancient India and contributed significantly to its expansion.
 
• One of his most notable achievements was **defeating Avanti (Malwa)**, a major kingdom that posed a significant threat to Magadh's dominance.
 
• After defeating Avanti, Shishunaga successfully **annexed the kingdom to Magadh**, thereby strengthening his empire and extending its boundaries to central India.
 
• The annexation of Avanti was crucial as it eliminated a key rival and allowed Magadh to emerge as the most powerful kingdom in northern India during that era.
 
• This victory paved the way for later rulers of Magadh, such as the Nanda dynasty and Maurya dynasty, to further expand the empire and establish its supremacy.
